headline: UDR Q2 FFO & Revenues Beat Estimates on Leasing Strength, '26 View Up
summary: UDR outpaces Q2 FFO estimates, delivers stronger leasing and same-store growth, and raises its 2026 FFO outlook as occupancy and resident retention remain strong.
